job.title: IT Delivery Lead
job.description:
The opportunity
Our government client is moving to a single Oracle platform to consolidate common processes, data and reporting. The approach is a standard Oracle solution with minimal customisation, aligned to the All-of-Government Common Process Model. Design wraps up in December 2026, and Oracle HCM, Finance and Procurement go live by June 2027.

The role
You'll be the client's technical lead, working alongside the Delivery Partner and reporting to the Programme Manager. Your job is to make sure what gets built matches the approved design and architecture, and to keep technical risks and partner performance under control.

What you'll do
  • Be the go-to technical authority across Oracle Finance, HCM, Procurement, EPM and integrations
  • Guide technical delivery from design through build, testing, cutover and hypercare
  • Challenge the Delivery Partner constructively and make sure knowledge is handed over
  • Oversee environments, releases, integrations and data migration
  • Provide technical assurance at stage gates and go-live
  • Support governance forums and keep the Project Manager well informed with clear reporting and early escalation
What you'll bring
  • 5+ years leading technical delivery of large enterprise transformation programmes
  • Hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud delivery, ideally across Finance, Procurement and HCM
  • Strong grounding in architecture, integration, environment and release management
  • Experience managing delivery partners and vendors
  • Solid governance, risk and quality assurance skills
  • Experience in large public-sector or similarly complex organisations
  • Great stakeholder skills, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams
Bonus points for:
NZ government experience, mergers or consolidations, All-of-Government Common Process Model, Oracle EPM, and familiarity with PRINCE2, MSP, PMBoK and or Agile delivery.

You are
A pragmatic leader who balances risk and progress, stays calm under pressure, and backs decisions with evidence. You're collaborative, influential, and committed to quality and sustainable outcomes.

Interested?
Apply with your CV through SEEK, or contact Tom Stephens at Momentum Consulting Group for a confidential chat.

- Provide enterprise-wide strategic leadership and influence to embed a proactive, risk-based HSW framework that directly supports organisational performance, sustainability and risk maturity.

- Support the safety and wellbeing of employees and the people the organisation supports through strong systems, clear leadership accountability and continuous learning.

- Support the organisation to move from compliance-focused activity to a proactive, prevention-oriented and insight-led approach to health & safety.

- Working as part of the Quality, Risk and Assurance function, strengthen organisational capability, support leaders to take ownership of safety, and ensure the organisation meets its legislative, contractual and regulatory obligations.

- Demonstrated expertise in HS&W, ideally within the Healthcare sector, or within similar service sectors with a complex and multi-site environment.
- Strong knowledge of New Zealand’s HS&W legislation, proven risk management capability, and experience with audits and investigations.
- Proven ability to engage and influence at all organisational levels, from senior management to frontline.
- Adept with championing a whole-of-organisation approach to Health & Safety.
- A collaborative, values-based H&S business partner with a passion for creating culturally safe practice, and an inclusive and supportive environment for all.
- Flexible to travel regularly around the Auckland sites and to the other locations in Northland, Waikato, and Christchurch with some regularity.

For You:
